rows.quote: Ultimately, we consolidated the OC‐GWAS data from these sources using GWAS meta‐analysis for further comprehensive analysis (sample case = 3547, N = 691,466).
rows.coder_note: The sentence defines the outcome dataset as the authors' own GWAS meta-analysis of several oral cancer sources (3547 cases, N = 691,466); the dictionary has no row for it.
The passages give the name with N = 54,219 only and no citation; N alone does not identify a release, and 54,219 is the sample size of no UKB-PPP row.

rows.quote: This dataset is derived from a pQTL study involving 35,559 Icelanders [12].
rows.reference_quote: E. Ferkingstad , P. Sulem , B. A. Atlason , et al., “ Large‐Scale Integration of the Plasma Proteome With Genetics and Disease ,” Nature Genetics 53 , no. 12 ( 2021 ): 1712 – 1721 . 34857953 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: The sentence, continuing the description of the deCODE exposure set (rule F), attributes the dataset to ref 12, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is the Ferkingstad 2021 row's source and no other row's; 35,559 Icelanders and 4907 proteins agree with that row.
